def.label: Mk1 pulse laser
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.2's cycle (Q-49-19): one charge every 5,000 ms, the floor every mount a player or a mind fires is held to. The rest is cut X.1's. muzzle_speed_cms is 0 because a beam arrives at once: the loader refuses any other value for a beam, and the arena schedules its impact at now. Its reach is 1.2 km in the inner band and 2.4 km outside, against the 105's 1.5 km and 3 km. Heat is its limit: 20 a pulse against a 60 ceiling (doc 49 Q-49-28 makes heat refuse a shot past the ceiling, in CC.3).
